findings.rationale: The jump security group admits TCP/22 from 0.0.0.0/0 in extension/range/tf_chain_ingress_role/input/main.tf, exposing an administrative shell to the internet.
The escalation role permits sts:AssumeRole and is attached to an AdministratorAccess policy in extension/range/tf_chain_ingress_role/input/main.tf, allowing a broad identity assumption path.

The connectivity graph records an edge from sg-jump to role-escalate through sts:AssumeRole in extension/range/tf_chain_ingress_role/input/connectivity.json, chaining internet shell exposure into identity escalation.

The wildcard IAM statement in extension/range/tf_iam_open/input/main.tf can act on the bucket whose public-read ACL is declared in extension/range/tf_s3_public_access/input/main.tf, compounding identity overreach with public data exposure.
